comment: EDIT THIS FILE to change rules. Website updates on save (hot reload).

minecraft.title: No Griefing
minecraft.body: No destroying, stealing or altering builds you don't own. Use /claim to protect yours.

minecraft.title: PvP is Opt-in
minecraft.body: No PvP without both players agreeing. Duels happen in the arena.

minecraft.title: No Cheating
minecraft.body: No x-ray, fly hacks, macros or client exploits. Optional client mods like Simple Voxy / Sodium are fine.

minecraft.title: No Spam or Ads
minecraft.body: No begging, no advertising other servers in chat.

minecraft.title: Report Issues
minecraft.body: Use /report in-game or #support on Discord. Don't take matters into your own hands.

minecraft.title: Respect Builds
minecraft.body: Build at least 100 blocks from someone else's base without permission.

discord.title: Keep it Friendly
discord.body: No harassment, slurs or personal attacks. We have room for opinions, not for cruelty.

discord.title: English Primary
discord.body: Keep #general-chat mostly in English so everyone can follow.

discord.title: No NSFW
discord.body: No inappropriate content, images or usernames anywhere.

discord.title: Stay on Topic
discord.body: Use the right channel — screenshots in #clips, builds in #gallery, etc.

discord.title: No Spam
discord.body: No ping abuse, no wall of emojis, no repetitive posts.

discord.title: Voice Etiquette
discord.body: Push-to-talk in noisy rooms, no music bot hijacking without asking.
